title: Ubiquity and Pervasive Market Expansion
primary_theme: Software Beyond the Screen and Clear Seed-Stage Storytelling
founder_lessons: Say what the product does in simple words within the first 30 seconds.
Anchor a technical pitch in whether it works, whether anyone wants it, whether many people want it, and whether customers can be found.
Show the first high-integrity signal that a customer outside your network wants the product.
Send investors crisp follow-up sound bites so they can accurately socialize the opportunity.
notable_quotes: software can now leap off of the computer screen and land in the real physical world
Does anyone want it? Are there a lot of those people? And can this entrepreneur find those people?
